texts.zh:
我们科研船最近一直在分析那个来自系外的声波信号，现在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]科研团队终于取得了突破性进展。

尽管信号中的大部分声波方程的含义我们仍不清楚，但我们母星上的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj][Root.GetScientistPlural]们已经确定该传输信号的数据与神秘L-星门上所用的科技数据是完全一致的！

单独进行分析的话，此信号的价值近乎为零，但如果将此信号与我们得到的关于远古传送门建造者的信息结合起来进行研究的话，可能就会让我们知道该如何重新启动这些L-星门。
texts.en:
Something of a breakthrough has been reached within the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] scientific community regarding the extragalactic sonified signal one of our Science Ships recently analyzed.

While the full meaning of the sonified equation embedded in the signal still eludes us, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [Root.GetScientistPlural] on our home world have been able to match enough of the transmission's data on subspace harmonics to the technology observed in the mysterious L-Gates!

Examined in isolation, the signal is of little further use to us. Analyzing it in conjunction with other insights into the ancient Gateway Builders, however, may yield valuable data on how these L-Gates could be reactivated.

texts.zh: 我们发现神秘容器上面的外星化合物是由纳米机器人的粉末组成的。外壳上的一些划痕中甚至有微小的机械爪痕，其中一个爪痕上有个纳米机器人正在从储存器中吸取能源。我们从纳米机器人的存储设备中提取到了一些数据，这些数据可以帮助我们更好地理解L-星团的传送门网络。
texts.en: We have discovered that the alien compound found on the enigmatic cache is made up of the powdered fragments of microscopic robotic entities - nanites. Some of the scratches in the hull even have tiny mechanical claws stuck in them, and in one we discovered an active but damaged nanite leeching its energy from the cache. From what remained of the nanite's hard drive we have extracted data that could be pivotal for our understanding of the L-cluster Gateway network.

texts.zh:
从[big_rip_planet.GetName]的废墟中回收的众多物品中有一个全息图像，该全息图像来自于某个对植物类[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]生活进行干涉的社会。虽然全息图像中的大部分数据已经损坏的难以辨识，我们还是成功的恢复了几个含有关于传送门网络的关键信息的片段。

大部分全息图像似乎是用来警告灰色风暴将会带来的毁灭性灾难的。
texts.en:
Among the items recovered from the ruins on [big_rip_planet.GetName] was a malfunctioning hologram from the society that interfered with the plantoid [GetPreFTLLowerPlural]. Though most of the data was either corrupted or unintelligible due to an incessant whooshing sound and the panicked state of the sender, we managed to restore several fragments containing valuable information on the Gateway network.

Most of the hologram, however, was dedicated to sickening premonitions of the Gray Tempest and the gruesome death that would follow in its wake.

texts.zh:
出于安全考虑，我们给所有从西万实验室返回的船员们都进行了全面的消毒，在消毒过程中，我们发现船员的防护外套上面附有某种外星物质，经过仔细研究发现这是某种变成了灰色尘埃的微型机器人碎片。最后我们在这些外星物质中找到了一个完整的纳米机器人，该机器人身上携带着给某个建筑安装螺栓的指令，我们认为那个建筑应该是一个传送门。

这个纳米机器人从事的工作应该是“组装整个L-星门网络”这一系统工程中的一小部分。
texts.en:
As the crew returning from the Xvan labs were decontaminated we identified an alien substance on their protective wear. Upon closer examination it has proven to be fragments of microscopic robots turned into a fine gray dust. Among the samples we found an intact nanite carrying instructions for attaching bolts to a structure we believe could be a Gateway.

This molecular construct maybe have had an integral part in assembling the entire L-Gate network.

texts.zh: 虽然当时并不明显，但[From.GetName]最近进行的勘探，在报告传回[Root.Capital.GetName]上的科学界之后，似乎使L-星门谜团的研究有了突破性的进展。
texts.en: It was not immediately apparent at the time, but the recent survey carried out by the [From.GetName] seemingly sparked a breakthrough in the ongoing study of the mysterious L-Gates when the report filtered back to the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName].
